Review the exact committed Testcenter rewrite change ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271..88a7ab1c4a29cd3d44be0bcaef461aef7d532e68. Your dimension is code-review. Find concrete correctness, regression, lifecycle, rendering/control and test-contract defects introduced by the patch. Verify identity precision, profile selection, auth transitions and asynchronous work.
Inspect the actual diff and source. The worktree is pinned to HEAD. Original is read-only at /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/en/work/testcenter-original (eedae41840cbe90e5547c0211da818bdf620f5aa). Preserve stronger tenant/workspace/group boundaries and existing browser, deadline, privacy and 470kB budget gates.
Establish scope from the actual diff, checked-in documentation and commit-matched evidence. Incremental checks do not prove whole-project parity. Verify whether older open handoff issues remain open; report concrete introduced defects rather than merely restating unfinished project scope.
Historical validation receipts: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/outputs/testcenter-native-monitor-ui-20261028.json and /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/native-monitor-ui-cache-env-proof/result.json. Match each claim to its actual commit, tree, scenario and result. Historical success cannot qualify a newer HEAD; historical failures may have been fixed. Do not claim current CI success without current matching evidence.
Return requested JSON only. Findings need a tracked repository-relative path, exact current line, evidence and remedy. Use request_changes for any unresolved substantive defect, inconclusive if review could not complete, unknown for missing signal evidence. Explain what you actually verified and the remaining limits.
I’ll inspect the committed diff, repository guidance, and the supplied validation receipts, then trace the changed behavior through its callers and tests.

The supplied receipt identifies this HEAD and records focused checks, but it explicitly leaves exact-head CI pending. I’m tracing the remaining route, profile, and session transitions against the implementation and the earlier reported issues.

I found a preset-Booklet transport mismatch and am checking the dialog dependency and route lifetimes before completing the review. The earlier Goto, enrichment, state-label, and pending-lock findings have corresponding fixes in this HEAD.

{
  "role": "code-review",
  "head": "88a7ab1c4a29cd3d44be0bcaef461aef7d532e68",
  "base": "ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271",
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "signal": "fail",
  "summary": "The native monitor has unresolved Booklet rendering, filter-dialog and profile-selection defects. The supplied receipt records focused validation at the reviewed commit, but does not establish current-head CI or whole-project parity.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/backend.service.ts",
      "line": 38,
      "title": "Resolve preset Booklet names to their physical file IDs",
      "evidence": "Monitor snapshots contain names such as ORACLE.POW.BOOK#monitor:first in the checked-in unopened-Test fixture. Encoding the entire name sends the fragment as path data; the native Booklet endpoint compares it to the physical Booklet identifier and returns 404. Those rows therefore render as missing Booklets and lack their block and unit controls. The browser smoke exercises an unadorned Booklet name.",
      "recommendation": "Extract the physical Booklet ID using the native Test-name rules before requesting and caching material, while retaining the complete Test name for identity and preset state. Add a browser or integration case with a preset name."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/group-monitor.component.ts",
      "line": 433,
      "title": "Provide the monitor injector to the filter dialog",
      "evidence": "AddFilterDialogComponent injects TestSessionManager, which is provided by NativeMonitorEntryComponent rather than the root injector. The dialog is opened without a viewContainerRef or an explicit injector, so its overlay cannot resolve that monitor-scoped service. Adding or editing a filter fails instead of opening the dialog.",
      "recommendation": "Open the dialog with the monitor component's view container or injector, and exercise adding and editing a filter through the real Angular dialog."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/native-monitor-entry.component.ts",
      "line": 40,
      "title": "Match the selected profile as well as the group",
      "evidence": "The entry guard accepts any child route whose group matches a claim, without checking its profile parameter. A direct or restored /group-monitor/<group> route is consequently accepted even when every claim for that group specifies a profile, and GroupMonitorComponent connects with default settings and no profile filters. With multiple profile claims, logging in on that route also bypasses the chooser.",
      "recommendation": "Require the route's group and profile to match a claim, including the absence of a profile only for an unprofiled claim. Otherwise show the chooser or navigate to the single matching claim."
    }
  ],
  "verified": [
    "Confirmed HEAD and tree identity, inspected the committed diff, the native monitor source and relevant API contracts, and compared selected behavior with the named Original checkout.",
    "Checked the earlier Goto confirmation, slow Booklet enrichment, state-label and pending-lock findings against the current implementation; their previously reported code paths have been changed.",
    "The supplied receipt associates its focused native tests, frontend tests, typecheck, 468.75 kB build and headed Chrome scenarios with HEAD 88a7ab1c and tree 45e0002ed30768432b244a812f382bdd29d89fc1. It states that exact-head CI was pending; the all-green CI claim belongs to the preceding commit.",
    "The separate cache-environment receipt concerns the earlier 5d9ba6c commit and does not qualify this HEAD."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "The repository Brain brief could not run because its lock directory could not be created in the read-only environment; source inspection was used instead.",
    "The historical validation results were inspected as receipts; broad suites were not rerun and their referenced logs were not independently revalidated.",
    "This review does not establish complete Original visual parity, receiver-side native command effects, or current CI success."
  ]
}
